item.title: Cocaine is now the biggest cause of drug deaths in England and Wales
item.body: Cocaine has overtaken heroin as the biggest cause of drug deaths in England and Wales, Office for National Statistics figures show. Cocaine caused 1,233 deaths last year, eight times the 2010 level. Charities say the government "must act now".

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 💔 Cocaine is now the biggest cause of drug deaths in England and Wales

Cocaine has overtaken heroin as the biggest cause of drug deaths in England and Wales, Office for National Statistics figures show. Cocaine caused 1,233 deaths last year, eight times the 2010 level. Charities say the government "must act now".

Source: Guardian | Image: Pixabay
